name: HyperX keyboards (Kingston ids)
description: Per-LED lighting of the HyperX keyboards with Kingston product ids: Alloy Elite RGB, Alloy FPS RGB, Alloy Elite 2, Alloy Origins, Alloy Origins 60. Adapted from OpenRGB's HyperXKeyboardController (GPL-2.0-or-later); untested on hardware. Only Direct reports are sent: never the Alloy Elite's profile commands, never brightness or other settings. The Alloy Origins Core (0951:16E6) is held back. Protocol notes: docs/hardware/hyperx-keyboard.md.
